name: gtheme sandbox control
description: TEST-ONLY. Enables unsafe mode inside a private headless GNOME Shell so the harness can drive the shell via org.gnome.Shell.Eval (hide the overview, inspect theme state, screenshot). Never install this into a real session: unsafe mode lets any bus client run arbitrary JS in the shell. It lives in the harness ext-root and is reachable only via XDG_DATA_DIRS set by sandbox-proof.sh.
